newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania average one-week rate down at 53 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania average one-week rate down at 53 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said the average accepted rate for its one-week refinancing funds inched down to 53 percent from last week's 53.33 percent.
At Thursday's auction, six banks bid 2.329 trillion lei, exceeding the offer of 2.315 trillion lei. They entered bids at prices equalling the BNR's minimum permitted rate, 53 percent.
The upswing in refinancing funds reflected a seasonal trend triggered by leu liquidity shortages in the banking sector ahead of Christmas and New Year holidays.
Traders said most banks were chasing money market funds which traded from 55 to 60 percent for short-term maturities.
Auction results are displayed on FXRP. ($=3,912 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
